recorded.prompt:q-builder-vs-factory:a: Read the page and each keyed question. For every wrong option, say whether a passage of the page rules it out, and quote or name that passage.
recorded.pass:q-builder-vs-factory:a: an independent reader (36-creational-patterns q3), never the author
recorded.outcome:q-builder-vs-factory:a: ruled out: The page reverses these roles: "Factory Method: ... The focus is on WHICH type to create, not HOW to construct it" (Factory decides the type), while Builder is 'Used when the object has many optional parameters' (Builder handles the optional fields, not the Factory).
recorded.prompt:q-builder-vs-factory:c: Read the page and each keyed question. For every wrong option, say whether a passage of the page rules it out, and quote or name that passage.
recorded.pass:q-builder-vs-factory:c: an independent reader (36-creational-patterns q3), never the author
recorded.outcome:q-builder-vs-factory:c: ruled out: The page lists Director as optional ("Director (optional) -- defines the order... Not always needed in the fluent builder variant") and describes the fluent Builder explicitly: "No Director -- the client controls the order of steps." So a Builder can run without a Director.
recorded.prompt:q-director:a: Read the page and each keyed question. For every wrong option, say whether a passage of the page rules it out, and quote or name that passage.
recorded.pass:q-director:a: an independent reader (36-creational-patterns q3), never the author
recorded.outcome:q-director:a: ruled out: Returning 'this' for chaining is attributed to the fluent (Effective Java) Builder, which the page says has 'No Director' at all: "Effective Java (Fluent) Builder: ... No Director -- the client controls the order of steps... Returns 'this' for method chaining (fluent API)."
recorded.prompt:q-director:b: Read the page and each keyed question. For every wrong option, say whether a passage of the page rules it out, and quote or name that passage.
recorded.pass:q-director:b: an independent reader (36-creational-patterns q3), never the author
recorded.outcome:q-director:b: ruled out: The private constructor is described as part of the Product, not the Director: "The private constructor takes a Builder and extracts all values." The Director's stated job is only "The Director defines the ORDER of construction steps."
